title: UX Phase 1 - new screens scaffold (backpack, compose, docustream)
objective: Create packages/mobile-app/app/backpack.tsx, compose.tsx, and docustream.tsx with full UI from docs/dev-only/prototypes/. Use internal useState mock only - no live context calls. Port Lucide icons to Ionicons. Each file must compile under tsc --noEmit.
acceptanceCriteria: app/backpack.tsx: card-based list with Switch toggles for profile/interests/location; educational Web3 info box.
app/compose.tsx: Trust Circles orbital UI with three concentric dashed rings (local/verified/foaf), center user node, dynamic audience label.
app/docustream.tsx: infinite-scroll timeline with ALL/REDDIT/X/RSS filter tabs, Save to Pod and Share to Grid actions per item.
All three files compile clean under tsc --noEmit with no imports of SolidContext, WalletContext, or DocustreamManager.
No existing files modified.

title: UX Phase 1 - augment feed, profile, settings
objective: Augment three existing screens: (a) Add Algorithm Tuner bottom-sheet modal to feed.tsx (sliders + SFW switch, internal state). (b) Add Shared Threads gradient card + ZK badge tooltip to profile.tsx (mock state). (c) Remove WebACL toggles from settings.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: feed.tsx: Tuner icon opens bottom-sheet with Serendipity/Deep Ties sliders (0-100) and SFW Mode switch; existing fetchFeed logic untouched.
profile.tsx: non-empty sharedThreads mock renders gradient Shared Threads card; ZK shield opens educational tooltip.
settings.tsx: WebACL/Pod permission toggles removed; remaining settings intact.
tsc --noEmit clean. No new files created.

title: UX Phase 1 - navigation restructure and dependency additions
objective: Restructure _layout.tsx to match prototype bottom nav and register all new routes. Add npm deps.
acceptanceCriteria: package.json: @react-native-community/slider and react-native-rss-parser added.
_layout.tsx: bottom nav primary bar = Local Grid | + Compose | Docustream; Backpack reachable from Profile header icon.
Routes registered: /, /feed, /local, /compose, /backpack, /docustream, /profile, /settings.
tsc --noEmit clean.

title: UX Phase 1 - solid-pod-sync backend methods
objective: Add updateWebACL(), findSemanticOverlap(), and DocustreamManager.ts to packages/solid-pod-sync/src/.
acceptanceCriteria: ProfileManager.ts: updateWebACL(containerPath, isPublic) patches .acl resource for public acl:Read.
SocialGraph.ts: findSemanticOverlap(peerWebId) intersects peer schema:interest triples with local interests[], returns string[].
DocustreamManager.ts: appendActivity(podRoot, item) and listActivities(podRoot) using W3C ActivityStreams 2.0 RDF in /public/docustream/.
index.ts re-exports all new types/classes.
Existing 12 tests pass. Unit test stubs added for each new method.
tsc --noEmit clean.

title: UX Phase 2 - context binding (Backpack, Docustream, Profile overlap)
objective: Replace mock state in Phase 1 screens with live context calls (L1-L4 must be merged first).
acceptanceCriteria: backpack.tsx togglePermission calls updateWebACL() via SolidContext.
docustream.tsx fetches RSS via react-native-rss-parser, writes to DocustreamManager.appendActivity(), reads via listActivities().
profile.tsx calls findSemanticOverlap(peerWebId); renders Shared Threads card only when result.length > 0.
tsc --noEmit clean. No regressions to feed/local/settings/index.

title: UX Phase 2 - compose audience routing via P2P/Pod/ZK
objective: Implement handlePost in compose.tsx routing payload by audience selection (L1+L3 must be merged).
acceptanceCriteria: local: P2PChannel.send() scoped to getSurroundingNodes() neighbours via DiscoveryContext.
foaf: encrypted write to Pod /outbox/ LDP; recipients from SocialGraph foaf:knows.
verified: same as foaf with WalletContext.verifyPoH(recipientWebId) guard per recipient.
ActivityIndicator during in-flight; error Toast on failure.
tsc --noEmit clean. Local post visible to second test client via relay within 5s.
